root: ^Companion: A bunk bed, a washbasin, a mirror ... I know where you are! This must be a third-class cabin.
^Companion: But you won't find anyone with enough authority here. We need someone who can help us stop the disaster.
^Companion: Go to the Grand Staircase. Find someone who can tell you where to find an officer.
^add_quest:staircase_officer:Go to the Grand Staircase and find someone who can help you reach an officer
